Garnier.title: Keratin Sleek Conditioner
Garnier.description:
For frizz-prone and dry hair, achieve a long-lasting sleek look with the Garnier Keratin Sleek range. This Keratin Sleek Conditioner is the second step of your sleek routine, powered by a 10% Keratin Smoothing Complex and nourishing Argan Oil. This conditioner formula effortlessly detangles and softens the hair, leaving it feeling incredibly smooth and manageable with up to 93% shinier* locks. For a complete transformation, follow the complete Keratin Sleek System: cleanse with the Shampoo, use this Conditioner to detangle or the Mask for an intense treatment, and finish with the Diamond Sleek Shine-Coat Smoothing Spray for a long-lasting sleek look with diamond-like shine. Garnier.title: Diamond Sleek Smoothing Spray
Garnier.description:
Dull-looking hair with frizz? No problem! Our Diamond Sleek Shine-Coat Smoothing Spray, with its 8% Keratin Smoothing Complex and Argan Oil, shields and smooths hair to reduce frizz even in high humidity. It works by coating the hair fibre to boost light reflection from all angles, delivering a stunning diamond-like shine that lasts for up to 100 hours*. The lightweight, non-greasy, and non-sticky texture ensures a natural feel without any weigh-down. This heat-activated formula also provides essential protection from heat styling tools, including from blow drying and straightening, up to 230 C*. For best results, use as a final step after the 3-step Keratin Sleek System. After the Shampoo, Conditioner, or Mask, apply Diamond Sleek Spray to achieve a long-lasting sleek look with incredible, polished shine. Vegan Formula**. Approved by Cruelty-Free International.

*Instrumental tests using standard shampoo + Diamond Sleek Spray
**No animal-derived ingredients or by-products
